question: Which ordinary activities are included within the field of power described here?
premises: The verse lists movements, states, and transitions of ordinary life.
It includes waking-dream alternation and opening-closing.
It culminates in effort and the feeling of power.
inference: A wide range of ordinary bodily and mental activities are expressions within the same field of power.
uncertainties: The pairing of unmeṣaṇa-nimeṣaṇa with svapna-jāgrat is compact and may be read in more than one way.
plain_english: Going and standing, dream and waking, opening and closing, running and leaping, effort and the feeling of power are all included here.
